scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && rm -rf server/public && cp -r web/dist server/public
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web && node scripts/design-lint.mjs
